about: How this repo relates to the HyperBench hub its conventions came from. Existing-fleet adoption (hub docs/ADOPT_EXISTING_REPO.md): what was copied is host-owned; later hub changes arrive only by an intentional reconciliation PR here. hyperbenchVersion is source provenance only. At operator direction only the memory, decision and orientation surfaces are adopted (memory/mem-001). line-endings is skipped because its checker requires every tracked file to be LF, and this fork keeps upstream FreeAllegiance files byte-identical (about 314 are committed with CRLF) so upstream merges stay clean; HyperBench-owned paths get scoped eol=lf rules in .gitattributes instead. tools/check_map.py is changed only to compare against origin/master, this fork's default branch.
